text: Objectives The Master of Science program in Applied Mathematics is designed for people who wish to work independently in teaching and research in math related fields. The program provides solid theory and systematic research skills in the areas of applied mathematics. We encourage our students to be systematic, professionally ethical, and internationally competent. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Differential Equations Theory and Application 2. Numerical Analysis and Scientific Computing 3. Time Series Analysis 4. Financial Mathematics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 32 credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
